draft.title: The Out of Africa theory
card: The Out of Africa theory is the idea that modern humans (Homo sapiens) first evolved in Africa. Most scientists support it, based on fossils and genetic evidence.
Over many thousands of years, groups of people moved out of Africa. They spread into Asia, Europe, Australia and, much later, the Americas.
Two things moved these groups: changes in climate and the search for food. When the climate changed, plants and animals changed too, so people followed them to new places.
Spreading was slow. It was not one trip. Groups settled new areas over many generations.
draft.remember: Modern humans began in Africa, then moved to new lands as climate and food supply changed.

a.q: According to the Out of Africa theory, where did modern humans first evolve?
opts: Africa
Asia
Europe
Australia
a.why: The theory says modern humans first evolved in Africa and then spread across the world. Asia and Europe were reached later by groups who moved out of Africa.
a.clue: Look at the name of the theory.

b.q: Why did groups of early humans move into new lands, according to the theory?
opts: Climate changed and they searched for food
Rulers sent them to build new cities
They wanted to trade goods with far countries
They left after a single war in Africa
b.why: The card says changes in climate and the search for food moved people, as plants and animals changed. Trading and ruling are not the reasons given, and the spread took many generations, not one event.
b.clue: Think about what people needed to live when the climate changed.

b.best: Climate changed and they searched for food

a.q: Which statement matches what most scientists think about where modern humans came from?
opts: They evolved in Africa, then spread to other lands
They evolved in Asia, then spread into Africa
They evolved separately on each continent
They evolved in Africa and never left it
a.why: Most scientists think Homo sapiens first evolved in Africa, then groups moved out over many generations. The idea that they evolved in Africa and stayed there is wrong, because groups later spread into Asia, Europe, Australia and the Americas.
a.clue: There are two parts: where humans began and what happened next.
